subject: Every string the arrange.regions surface exposes to AX in de-DE
question: What labels does Logic show on arrange.regions in de-DE, and on which elements?

reverify.expected: a census in de-DE whose arrange.regions rows carry the same 28 distinct strings; a differing set means Logic's labels moved and every provenance citing this record wants re-reading
reverify.cost: ~1 min with Logic open on the fixture project in that locale

method: Read, never actuated. The menu bar and every menu were walked without opening them; the main window was walked to depth 8. Each element with any string became one row of the evidence file; rows were assigned to this surface by what their path or help text passes through, and rows no rule could place are counted in limits rather than filed.

strings: Arbeitsbereich. Der Hauptbereich für Aufnahme, Bearbeitung und Arrangement von Audio- und MIDI- und Session Player-Regionen, der in verschiedene Spurtypen eingeteilt ist.

Region beginnt bei 1 Takt  und endet bei 2 Takte , MIDI-Region. Enthält MIDI-Noten- und Controller-Events. Durch Bewegen der Mitte werden Regionen verschoben, mit den unteren Rändern skaliert und mit dem oberen rechten Rand als Loop gespielt. Verwende für andere Bearbeitungen die entsprechenden Werkzeuge.
Taste „Spuren hinzufügen“. Füge Spuren für Audio- und Software-Instrumente hinzu. Verwende Spuren für Aufnahme, Bearbeitung und Arrangement von Regionen.

conclusion: On this host in de-DE, arrange.regions exposes 62 elements carrying 28 distinct strings. Every string is in the evidence file verbatim, which is what lets a label variant cite this record: the guard requires the string to occur in the observations or evidence, and here it does or it does not.
limits: Navigation-free surfaces only: nothing behind a menu press or a button was opened, so this says nothing about the mixer, plug-in editors or the editors.
315 window rows matched no surface rule and are not filed under any record; they are in the evidence file and can be re-classified when a rule exists.
One project, one host, one build. A label that depends on project content — a track name, a region name — is a reading of this fixture, not of Logic.
